title: Bollywood films dominate first half of 2026 box office
summary: The Bollywood film industry has seen a surge in popularity during the first half of 2026, with 'Dhurandhar 2' and 'Border 2' emerging as top winners. This trend is expected to continue as the second half of the year approaches. The success of these films can be attributed to their engaging storylines and strong marketing campaigns.
summary_points: Bollywood film industry has seen a significant increase in popularity during the first half of 2026
Films like 'Dhurandhar 2' and 'Border 2' have emerged as top winners at the box office
The success of these films can be attributed to their engaging storylines and strong marketing campaigns
This trend is expected to continue as the second half of the year approaches
The Indian film industry's performance will likely impact the country's economy
title_hi: बॉलीवुड फिल्में 2026 के पहले halves में बॉक्स ऑफिस पर नेतृत्व कर रही हैं
summary_hi: बॉलीवुड फिल्म उद्योग ने 2026 के पहले halves में एक महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि देखी है, जहां 'धुरंधर 2' और 'बॉर्डर 2' बॉक्स ऑफिस पर शीर्ष जीतने वाली फिल्में रहीं। यह प्रवृत्ति आगामी वर्ष के दूसरे halves में बनाए रखने की उम्मीद है। इन फिल्मों की सफलता उनके आकर्षक कहानियों और मजबूत मार्केटिंग अभियानों के कारण हो सकती है।
